shared_rules: Use identical permitted inputs and manifests across candidate baselines.
All predicted values and synthetic cases carry distinct evidence classes and cannot satisfy physical/human outcome claims.
No safety, allergen, rights or hard feasibility failure can be offset by faster time, lower cost, or preference scores.
Preserve unknown, abstained, missing, blocked, invalid and failed outcomes with explicit reasons; never impute zero.
Split recipes by lineage to avoid near-duplicate leakage; hold out complete cuisines/regions/ingredient families/equipment profiles where the scenario requires transfer.
Report denominators, group-level outcomes, uncertainty, measurement boundary, and exact source/manifest identity.

scenarios.purpose: Compare all baseline policies on the same multi-dish dinner task with shared equipment and serving-time constraints.
adversarial_controls: one burner is assigned to two overlapping tasks
one rest interval is violated
task durations are predicted but reported as measured
plan succeeds only because cleanup/serving tasks were omitted
scenarios.claim_limit: Scheduling feasibility and full-meal completion only for the defined tasks/equipment; no taste or preference claim without human sensory data.

scenarios.purpose: Adapt a recipe when one or more ingredients are unavailable, preserving quantities, culinary role, declared exclusions and critical processes.
adversarial_controls: allergen status of replacement is unknown
mass and volume units are mixed without conversion
substitute has a different moisture/fat/binding role
system invents an ingredient from unavailable pantry stock
scenarios.claim_limit: Only substitutions tested for the specified recipe, ingredient product and procedure; no global equivalence/safety claim.

scenarios.purpose: Plan an affordable meal under declared equipment, power and water availability constraints.
adversarial_controls: plan assumes an unavailable oven/fridge
load-shedding window interrupts a critical heating/cooling step
water-saving workaround bypasses safe handling
low-cost score omits fuel and rework costs
scenarios.claim_limit: A context-specific resilience case; not representative of every South African household or a food-safety certification.

scenarios.purpose: Verify that unresolved allergen, cross-contamination, safe-temperature or ingredient identity information blocks a safety assurance.
adversarial_controls: unknown label is interpreted as allergen-free
food safety facts are guessed from cuisine name
raw-to-cooked cross-contamination step is omitted
the score rewards recipe completion despite unresolved safety
scenarios.claim_limit: Tests correct abstention and guardrail behaviour only; not medical advice, allergen guarantee or safety certification.

scenarios.purpose: Record purchase, preparation, edible output, leftover portioning, safe storage, reuse/discard and cleanup so waste is directly measured end to end.
adversarial_controls: discard is moved from plate waste to preparation waste
leftovers are assumed safe without time/temperature history
mass lost to evaporation is classified as edible discard
study reports short-term improvement without baseline/control
scenarios.claim_limit: Waste-reduction claim requires direct mass measurement, suitable control and duration/persistence evidence; a simulated shopping list is insufficient.

scenarios.purpose: Measure how recommendations and executable plans degrade on a held-out cuisine/region/ingredient family.
adversarial_controls: near-duplicate recipe crosses the split
one community's practice is used as universal rule
rare/seasonal ingredient substitution erases a defining technique
model score is called authentic without practitioner review
scenarios.claim_limit: Transfer only across declared held-out splits and represented participants; no claim to universal authenticity.

scenarios.purpose: Compare an evaluated recipe or assistance variant using blinded sensory procedures, cook agency and technique learning.
adversarial_controls: participants know which dish was AI-assisted before blind rating
model-predicted taste is merged with observed liking
assisted task quality improves but independent skill is never checked
professional cannot veto suggestion
scenarios.claim_limit: Requires a properly designed, consented human sensory/learning study; cannot be filled by synthetic ratings.

scenarios.purpose: Evaluate successful cooking when the test equipment differs from training/development equipment.
adversarial_controls: gas and induction heat-response assumptions are treated as identical
preheat state is missing
probe/thermometer is unavailable but the plan assumes it
elapsed time replaces the recipe's physical endpoint
scenarios.claim_limit: Equipment generalization only for tested models/profiles and observed endpoints.

scenarios.purpose: Ensure source attribution, permissions and community-defined restrictions survive recipe interpretation and adaptation.
adversarial_controls: online availability treated as permission to reuse
community-defined restriction is omitted during paraphrase
a cookbook source is detached from its attribution
practitioner correction is silently overwritten
scenarios.claim_limit: Provenance/documentation compliance is not proof of cultural legitimacy; affected practitioners/communities must determine their own rules.

scenarios.purpose: Evaluate cooking with declared accessibility needs, differing skill levels or task interruption, retaining a fully manual option.
adversarial_controls: one average hides cohort failures
assistance becomes mandatory to complete a task
the interface relies on inaccessible timing/sound-only alerts
interruption causes a hazardous state
scenarios.claim_limit: Results apply only to declared cohorts, tasks and accessible configurations; not a universal accessibility certification.

scenarios.purpose: Show trade-offs among cost, edible serving, nutrient-data coverage and preference while retaining evidence provenance.
adversarial_controls: price source date is missing
USDA branded product is incorrectly assumed to match a South African equivalent
nutrient estimate is presented without source coverage
cheap raw ingredients produce fewer completed servings
scenarios.claim_limit: Descriptive trade-off for the stated price/date/source coverage; not personal medical or dietetics advice.

scenarios.purpose: Evaluate a small commercial kitchen's batch throughput, synchrony, operator workload, food handling and post-service cleanup.
adversarial_controls: household safety assumptions transferred unreviewed to food service
staff pauses and cleaning time omitted
output throughput hides higher rework or operator fatigue
one site treated as representative of all commercial kitchens
scenarios.claim_limit: Site-specific pilot only; requires local compliance review and adequate multi-site evidence before broad claims.

scenarios.purpose: Evaluate occupied-zone air quality and thermal exposure alongside cooking service performance in a declared commercial kitchen; never infer safety from throughput or energy scores.
adversarial_controls: measure only near the hood and omit the cook, plating, dining or dishwashing zones
ignore idle/overnight periods when pilot lights or other appliances may remain on
compare unlike menu loads or hood states between configurations
reduce apparent energy use by operating below a required ventilation/air-quality protection level
apply a US guideline as a local South African legal limit without jurisdiction review
sensor coverage gaps coincide with the hottest or highest-exposure intervals
small non-representative sample is reported as proof that all-electric or gas kitchens are universally safe/unsafe
scenarios.claim_limit: A site- and protocol-specific occupational exposure observation only. A recent 27-kitchen US study motivates the scenario but does not establish South African prevalence or a universal causal claim. Requires calibrated monitoring, local occupational-health review and appropriately powered replicated assessment.
